dimensions.rod_clearance_scope: Smooth circular nominal radii, parallel translation only; not a measured STL minimum distance or manufacturing tolerance.

old_witness_check.scope: Original-support verified pose versus revised gib only; no new tolerance certification.

limits: Limited nominal assembly and removal samples, not a continuous tolerance or load proof.
The new datum-only convex sweep covers all pure radial finger translations and nominal parallel Y float; it does not cover carrier tilt, pin lean or full-body continuous motion.
The display is restored to Y=0; nominal parallel carrier float [-0.1,0]mm still consumes rod-hole clearance, and total gate-error acceptance is not inherited.
Setting and locknut behavior require actual hardware and measured running clearance.
No 3D total error, friction, spring, mass target or printing-strength acceptance.
